name: Pay to Unlock WooCommerce Paywall – Capripio
author: Asif

sections.description:
Pay to Unlock WooCommerce Paywall – Capripio lets you lock specific sections of any post or page and charge readers to unlock them — no membership plugin needed.

Simply wrap content in the [cppu_unlock] shortcode or use the Gutenberg block, connect it to a WooCommerce product, and you’re done. Readers pay once and instantly see the content.

This plugin is not developed by or affiliated with WooCommerce or Automattic.

Why Pay to Unlock WooCommerce Paywall – Capripio?

  • Simpler than memberships — no subscriptions, no user roles, no drip systems
  • Sell premium paragraphs, code snippets, tutorials, templates, and more
  • Guest purchases supported — buyers don’t need an account
  • Instant unlock — no page reload after purchase

Features

  • Unlimited locked sections per post/page
  • Gutenberg block + shortcode support
  • Connect each lock to a WooCommerce product
  • Instant unlock after purchase
  • Guest purchases via secure token (no account required)
  • Four visual themes (Dark, Light, Minimal, Glass) with custom button colour
  • Blur/fade preview overlay with configurable word count
  • Purchase validation (buyers never pay twice)
  • Unlock & conversion analytics
sections.installation:
1. Upload the capripio-paywall-unlock folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress
  3. Ensure WooCommerce is installed and active
  4. Create a WooCommerce product for the content you want to sell

  5. Add a locked section using the Gutenberg block or shortcode:

    [cppu_unlock product_id=”123″ key=”my-section”]Your premium content here.[/cppu_unlock]
sections.faq:
Does the buyer need a WordPress account?

No. Guest purchases are fully supported using secure unlock tokens stored in a cookie.

What happens if a buyer requests a refund?

Access is not automatically revoked on refund. You can manually delete the unlock record from the database if needed.

Does this work with the block editor?

Yes. A dedicated Gutenberg block is included alongside shortcode support.

Is this plugin affiliated with WooCommerce or Automattic?

No. This is an independent plugin that integrates with WooCommerce. WooCommerce is a trademark of Automattic.
sections.changelog:
1.0.3

  • Fix: works with page caching (LiteSpeed Cache, WP Rocket, W3 Total Cache, host caches). Locked sections the visitor has bought are now loaded after the page loads, so buyers see their content even when the page comes from a cache.
  • Fix: pages showing unlocked content to a guest are never stored in the page cache, so a buyer’s unlocked page can’t be served to other visitors.
  • Fix: the “Already purchased?” form and inline checkout keep working on cached pages whose security tokens have expired.
  • Improvement: after paying in the inline checkout, the content unlocks in place without reloading, and waits a few seconds if the payment confirmation is delayed.

1.0.2

  • Improvement: guest buyers now get access automatically right after checkout (classic and block checkout) and on the order confirmation page, with no “Already purchased?” step.
  • Fix: sections tied to a grouped product now unlock when any of its child products is bought.
  • Fix: the “Already purchased?” form now works for orders placed while logged in, and for orders completed before the section was added.
  • Fix: the “Already purchased?” form now explains when the order does not include the product for that content, instead of reporting success.
  • Fix: the lock box preview no longer shows the whole locked text when it is short.
  • Fix: unlock analytics are counted once per purchase.

1.0.1

  • New: Pro version available, powered by Freemius (timed access, file/media locking, category rules, inline checkout, A/B testing, revenue analytics, reader library, RSS/REST protection, import/export).
  • New: developer hooks cppu_can_access, cppu_shortcode_atts, cppu_lock_box_args, cppu_record_unlock_args and cppu_after_record_unlock.
  • Fix: saving a post no longer clears its lock registry; sections are re-read from the content on save, so orders placed right after publishing unlock correctly.
  • Fix: PHP notice from a database query prepared without placeholders when an order completes.
  • Fix: buying again after timed access expired, or re-completing a refunded order, now restores access.
  • Improvement: compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS).
  • Improvement: the plugin declares WooCommerce as a required plugin and cannot be activated without it.

1.0.0

  • Initial release
